title: Win Back, Trusted Roll or Playably: Three Ways to Let Shopify Shoppers Win Their Order Free, Compared (2026)
summary: "Win your order free" is one of the few promotions that sells at full price. Shoppers pay what they'd pay anyway, and some walk away with the whole order back. But the three Shopify apps built on it disagree about almost everything else: how winners are picked, what they get, and who pays. This guide compares Win Back
